inputImages.role: 6번 교차 장갑형 자체를 다듬기 위한 편집 대상

decision: 사용자는 6번이 그나마 낫다고 평가하고 다듬기를 요청했다. 최종 승인으로 간주하지 않음.

variants.title: 6번 다듬은 안
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine the attached original rhythm-game FRAME DESIGN into a more resolved second pass. The attached image is the design to refine. Deliver ONE complete finished frame image, portrait 2:3, full frame completely inside the canvas, same straight-on camera, plain charcoal background. Do not return a before-and-after sheet.

KEEP the defining identity: two large overlapping faceted silver armor shells on each vertical pillar; one dramatic diagonal interlock near mid-height; deep blue-black inner structure and a recessed gold strip at that interlock; open top with NO top bridge; exactly FOUR equal-width dark empty lanes with three subtle dividers; four aligned input/propulsion units at the bottom. Keep the central lane opening at the same size. Maintain bilateral balance and the shared silver, slate-blue, blue-black and selective metallic gold palette.

Make a visible design refinement, concentrating on these corrections:
1. Refine the outer contour. The broad lower-middle armor plates in the original balloon out and then pinch abruptly. Narrow that bulge modestly, use a longer clean taper into the base, and unify the diagonal angles of the upper shell, lower shell and bottom corner armor. Preserve TWO broad armor planes per pillar; make the silhouette feel authored and continuous.
2. Resolve the diagonal interlock as an actual layered mechanical joint: an overlapping silver lip, a narrow dark cast-shadow gap, a recessed gold structural tongue, and a restrained dark load-bearing spine visible behind. Use consistent bevel widths and convincing plate thickness. No floating decorative plate pieces. The diagonal gold strip is an internal connector, never a luminous stripe.
3. Integrate the pillars into the bottom chassis. Replace the piled-up corner blocks and bottom stone-like faceting with one clear interlocking silver corner shell on each side, seated on a continuous dark structural crossbeam. The diagonal shell flow should connect naturally to the side edges of the four input modules. Lower the excessive front bumper mass slightly while retaining weight and support. No new badges or extra mechanical greebles.
4. Clarify input versus exhaust: give each of the four units a clearly readable shallow dark slate input plate on top, and exactly ONE compact continuous front-facing exhaust aperture below it. Simplify the excessive concentric lens rings into a single neat chamfered rim and dark recess; it should read as a propulsion outlet, not a camera lens. Keep all four units identical in mechanical geometry and do not add extra holes. The first and fourth apertures are off; second pale cyan and third warm gold. Both active apertures have the exact same single shape and restrained light, directed OUT OF THE SCREEN toward the viewer, never a downward jet.
5. Improve the 2D painted metal treatment: deliberate fine linework, clean grouped cel-shadow planes, long narrow silver edge highlights and selective broad cool reflections. More distinction between matte dark skeleton and satin silver armor. Thin local cyan/gold bounce only near the active outlets. No brushed noise, scratches, chrome mirror render, weathering, extra glowing stripes, or glossy plastic. Keep broad armor faces calm and readable at gameplay size.
Keep the existing narrow blue gauge insets as quiet recessed details. Do not add text, labels, symbols, characters, human anatomy, wings, weapons, spikes, extra panels, floor, perspective, scenery or new HUD. This is one coherent refinement of this exact frame, not a new unrelated concept.
